label: Bible Study
prompt: Blow ye the _____ in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for it is nigh at hand;
verse: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for it is nigh at hand;
note: Joel's alarm — the trumpet in Zion, warning that the day of the LORD is near.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the _____ works of God.
verse: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
note: Elihu's advice to weary Job: stand still and consider the wondrous works of God — sometimes just look up.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became _____ unto it.
verse: And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse unto it.
note: Bitter Naomi ends the book with a baby in her lap — Obed, who would become King David's grandfather.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But they _____ the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till there was no remedy.
verse: But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till there was no remedy.
note: Why Jerusalem fell: Judah mocked the very messengers God sent to warn them, until there was no remedy.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And I will rebuke the _____ for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, saith the LORD of hosts.
verse: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, saith the LORD of hosts.
note: Bring the tithes, and God will 'rebuke the devourer' — no more crops lost before harvest. The promise right after the storehouse.
